scripts.title: Nyanza | OP Autofarm + Serverhop
scripts.features:
Nyanza script for Wanted
Fully autonomous multi-target Wanted money autofarm with serverhop.
Select your targets, press Start and walk away.

Bank Vault

Automatically obtains C4, opens the vault and collects main cash, pallets and all items. Handles the 20-minute bank reset automatically.

Jewelry

Clears jewelry cases and the vault. Optional Vault Cracker automatically buys, installs and operates the drill.

Vault Cracker (a Jewelry add-on)

If the vault is locked, it automatically buys a drill at the port, attaches it to the door, drill and automatically un-jam it, and then empties the vault. Meanwhile, it continues smashing standard display cases.

Military Chests

Farms military chests at the Fort Emberreach and automatically collected weapons at Rod.

Safes

Automatically opens safes through the backdoor without the keypad minigame.

ATMs

Automatically farms ATMs across the map.

Cash Registers

Automatically farms cash registers throughout downtown.

Sir B Sales

Sells bags to Sir B first for 2× the normal payout. Sir B sales have a ~4-hour payout delay, and the sales limit resets after 4 hours. Once the Black Market sales limit is reached, remaining bags are automatically sold to Ofy. Requires a Level 2 Agent.

Incognito Mode

Automatically purchases Incognito from the Syndicate Agent once at the start of farming. Cost and duration scale with your Incognito level. Incognito mode resets when server hopping.

All collected items are automatically sold according to your selected sales settings when the bag is full.

AUTOMATION HELPERS

Death Recovery
Recovers your dropped bag after death and resumes farming.

Damage Evade
Breaks contact and repositions when taking damage.

Auto-Reconnect
Reconnects after connection loss or timeout and resumes farming.

Game State
Skips already-looted locations and tracks bank reset timers.

Movement
Controlled fast teleport what bypasses Wanted AC with grounded movement for close-range actions.
